if_entity.description:
Used to execute the code inside it
if a certain condition related to an
entity or multiple entities is met.
examples: Check if an entity is a projectile

Check if an entity is a certain type
of mob
Check the name of an entity

control.description:
Used to control the execution of
some or all code blocks after it.
examples:
Pause the code sequence
for a certain duration
Stop the code sequence
Skip a repeat iteration

player_action.description:
Used to do something related to
a player or multiple players.
examples: Send a message to a player
Damage or heal a player
Clear a player's inventory

event.description:
Used to execute code when something
is done by (or happens to) a player.
examples: Detect when a player joins the plot
Detect when a player right clicks
Detect when a player dies

process.description:
Used to execute code when the process
is started using a Start Process block.
additional_information:
Set the process name by right clicking
the code block sign with a string.

Set the name color, icon, and lore of the
process by putting an item in the chest.

Processes are not a replacement for
Functions. Processes are much more CPU
intensive than functions, and should only
be used when needed.

start_process.description:
Used to start processes declared by
a Process block.
Waits inside the Process will not
stop this code line, unlike Functions.

else.description:
Used to execute the code inside it
if the condition directly before it
was not met. Else must be placed directly
after any If block's closing bracket.

entity_event.description:
Used to execute code when an entity
does something or when something
happens to an entity.
examples: Detect when a mob takes damage
Detect when a projectile kills a mob
Detect when a mob kills another mob

set_var.description: Used to set the value of a variable.
examples: Set a variable to a sum of numbers

Remove all instances of a certain
string from a string variable
Set a variable to a random value

func.description:
Used to define a line of code that can be
called with a Call Function block.
additional_information:
Set the function name by right clicking
the code block sign with a string.

Set the name color, icon, and lore of the
function by putting an item in the chest.

Put parameter items to specify the
parameters of the function.

Functions can also be used for continuing
lines of code that are out of space.

call_func.description:
Used to call functions declared by
a Function block.
Code will not continue past this block
until the Function completes/returns.

entity_action.description:
Used to do something related to
an entity or multiple entities.
examples: Set the age or size of a mob
Give a mob a potion effect
Delete an entity from the plot

game_event.description:
Used to execute code when something
happens in the world.
examples: Detect when a piston extends
Detect when a block is ignited
Detect when a block fades

game_action.description:
Used to do something related to
the plot and everyone playing it.
examples: Spawn a mob or other entity
Change a block or block region

if_player.description:
Used to execute the code inside it
if a certain condition related to a
player is met.
examples: Check if a player is swimming
Check if a player has an item
Check a player's username

if_var.description:
Used to execute the code inside it
if a certain condition related to the
value of a variable is met.
examples:
Check if a number variable is less
than or equal to another number

Check if a string variable contains
a certain string

Check if a variable is equal
to something

repeat.description: Used to repeat the code inside it.
examples: Repeat code forever

Repeat code a certain number
of times

Repeat code until a certain
condition is met

select_obj.description:
Used to change the selection on the
current line of code, which will affect
the targets of most code blocks.
examples: Select all players on the plot
Select a player with a certain username

Select all players on the plot that meet
a certain condition

if_game.description:
Used to execute code when something
in the world does something.
examples:
Check if a container has all of
a certain set of items

Check if a sign's text contains
a certain text

Check if a block at a certain
location is a certain block

started process.

or using the sprint key to swim.

gliding with elytra.

InWorldBorder.description:

a specific game mode.

pack.

IsSwimming.name: Is Swimming

the given block or location.

supported by a block.

OwnsProduct.name: Owns Product
additional_information:

purchase products.
OwnsProduct.description:
Checks if a player owns a plot
product or is a developer or
builder.

IsHolding.name: Is Holding Item
IsHolding.description:
Checks if a player is holding
an item in their hand.

IsBlocking.name: Is Blocking
IsBlocking.description:
Checks if a player is
blocking with a shield.

is within the radius.

within the radius.

on the X, Y or Z axis
is within the radius.

on the X or Z axis is
within the radius.

IsHitboxNear.description:
Checks if a player's hitbox is
within a range of a location.

Checks only if the
effect type matches.

The amplifier of the
player's effect must
be equal or higher.

The duration of the
player's effect must
be equal or higher.

of the player's effect
must be equal or higher.

HasPotion.description:
Checks if a player has a
potion effect of the given
type active.

NameEquals.name: Name Equals

NameEquals.description:
Checks if a player's username is
equal to one of the given
usernames (case insensitive).

CanFly.name: Can Fly

SetHotbar.name: Set Hotbar Items
SetHotbar.description:

hotbar.

SetReducedDebug.name: Set Reduced Debug Info Enabled
SetReducedDebug.description:
When enabled, a player won't be
able to see their coordinates,
block info, or other info.

GiveItems.name: Give Items
GiveItems.description:
Gives a player all of the
items in the chest.

SetHandCrafting.name: Set Allow Hand Crafting
SetHandCrafting.description:
Sets if a player is
allowed to interact with
their hand-crafting menu.

ParticleSphere.name: Display Particle Sphere
ParticleSphere.description:
Displays a sphere of particles

Particle.name: Display Particle Effect
Particle.description:
Displays a particle effect
to a player.

AddInvRow.name: Add Inventory Menu Row
AddInvRow.description:
Adds a row to the bottom of
a player's current inventory
menu.

DisplayLightning.name: Display Lightning Bolt
DisplayLightning.description:
Displays a lightning strike
effect to a player.

SetXPProg.description:
Sets the XP progress bar
to a certain percentage.

SetInventory.name: Set Inventory Items
SetInventory.description:
Sets items in a player's
upper inventory.

TpSequence.name: Teleport Sequence
TpSequence.description:
Teleports a player to multiple
locations, with a delay between
each teleport.

Heal.name: Heal

SetSpawnPoint.name: Set Spawn Point
SetSpawnPoint.description:
Sets the location a player will
spawn when they die and respawn.

SetInventoryKept.name: Set Inventory Kept
SetInventoryKept.description:
Sets whether a player's inventory
is kept after death.

LaunchUp.name: Launch Up
additional_information:
A negative launch power will
launch the player down.
LaunchUp.description: Launches a player up or down.

ForceFlight.name: Force Flight Mode
ForceFlight.description:
Forces a player to start
or stop flying.

LoadInv.name: Load Saved Inventory

Synchronous.description:
Waits for the inventory to
be loaded before continuing.

additional_information:
If no saved inventory exists,
the player's inventory will be
cleared.

Inventories loaded with 'Load
Saved Inventory' take several
ticks to load. Use 'Control:
Wait' if you need to check the
inventory's contents after it is
loaded.

ChatStyle.name: Set Chat Style
ChatStyle.description:
Sets a player's chat color or
decoration.

Kick.name: Kick
Kick.description:
Kicks a player from
the plot.

MiscAttribute.name: Set Miscellaneous Attribute

A percentage of the base value shown
above. 100% is equal to the base value.

Percentage (Relative).description:
A percentage of what the attribute
is currently set to. For example,
200% doubles the current value.

MiscAttribute.description:
Sets one of the player's miscellaneous
attributes such as scale and
burning time.

SpectateTarget.name: Spectate Target

True.description:
Color codes and style tags
are ignored when matching
an entity by its name.

False.description:
All color codes and style
tags in the entity's name
must match exactly.

additional_information:
The player must be in
spectator mode.
SpectateTarget.description:
Makes a player spectate
another player or entity.

HurtAnimation.name: Send Hurt Animation

notes:
Affects the direction of
the screen tilt effect.

HurtAnimation.description:
Makes a player perform
a hurt animation.

SurvivalMode.name: Set to Survival Mode
SurvivalMode.description:
Sets a player's game
mode to Survival.

DisplayBellRing.name: Display Bell Ring
DisplayBellRing.description:
Displays a bell ring animation
at a location to a player.

SetStatus.name: Set Status
additional_information:
A player's game status can be
seen when using /locate.
SetStatus.description:
Sets the player's game status,
which is used to display information
about what the player is doing
in the game.

SetCursorItem.name: Set Cursor Item
SetCursorItem.description:
Sets the item on a
player's cursor.

SetAbsorption.name: Set Absorption Health
additional_information:
The target does not need to
have an absorption effect.
SetAbsorption.description:
Sets a player's absorption
health (golden hearts).

SetFireTicks.name: Set Fire Ticks
additional_information:
0 ticks mean the target is
not on fire.
This triggers the Player Combust event.
SetFireTicks.description:
Sets the remaining time a
player is on fire for.

CombatAttribute.name: Set Combat Attribute

Percentage (Base).description:
A percentage of the base value shown
above. 100% is equal to the base value.

Percentage (Relative).description:
A percentage of what the attribute
is currently set to. For example,
200% doubles the current value.

CombatAttribute.description:
Sets one of the player's combat-related
attributes such as attack damage
and attack speed.

Respect Gamemode.description:
Follows the flight access given
to the gamemode.

Keep Original.description:
Does not change the target's
ability to fly before changing
the gamemode.

Creative.description:
Warning: a player can spawn
any item they wish through a
toolbar.

Click related events or game
values may not work like they
would in other gamemodes.

RemoveInvRow.name: Remove Inventory Menu Row
RemoveInvRow.description:
Removes the given number of
rows from the bottom of a player's
current inventory menu.

WakeUpAnimation.name: Send Wake Up Animation
WakeUpAnimation.description:
Displays the wake up (fade in)
animation to a player.

DisableBlocks.name: Disallow Placing/Breaking Blocks

notes:
If no blocks are given,
disallows all blocks

DisableBlocks.description:
Prevents a player from placing
and breaking certain blocks.

SetScoreObj.name: Set Scoreboard Objective Name
SetScoreObj.description:
Sets the objective name of the
scoreboard sidebar.

SetFreezeTicks.name: Set Freeze Ticks

Disable.description:
Player will slowly unfreeze
over time.

SetFreezeTicks.description:
Sets how long a player
is frozen for.

SetGliding.name: Set Gliding
additional_information:
The player must be
wearing an elytra.
SetGliding.description:
Sets whether a player
is gliding with elytra.

SetRotation.name: Set Rotation
SetRotation.description:
Changes a player's pitch and
yaw.

ClearItems.name: Clear Items
ClearItems.description:
Removes all of an item from
a player.

OpenSign.name: Open Sign
OpenSign.description:
Opens a sign for a player.
Also works with client-side signs.

SetFlying.name: Set Flying
SetFlying.description:
Sets whether a player
is flying.

DisplayBlockOpen.name: Display Block Opened State
DisplayBlockOpen.description:
Displays a container block
at a location as being open
or closed to a player.

SendAdvancement.name: Send Advancement
SendAdvancement.description:
Displays a custom advancement
popup to a player.

SetMenuItem.name: Set Inventory Menu Item
SetMenuItem.description:
Sets the item in a slot
of a player's current
inventory menu.

LaunchToward.name: Launch Toward Location
additional_information:
A negative launch power will launch
the player away from the location.
LaunchToward.description:
Launches a player toward or away
from a location.

SetArmor.name: Set Armor Items
additional_information:
Any block or item can render
on the target's head if placed
in the 'helmet' slot.
SetArmor.description:
Sets a player's armor items.
Place the armor in slots 1-4
of the chest, with 1 being the
helmet and 4 being the boots.

DisplayGateway.name: Display Gateway Beam

Initial beam.description:
A magenta beam.
Plays for 200 ticks.

Periodic beam.description:
A purple beam.
Plays for 40 ticks.

DisplayGateway.description:
Displays a vertical beam on
an end gateway to a player.

DisplayEquipment.name: Display Equipment Change
additional_information:
Any block or item can render
on the entity's head if placed
in the 'helmet' slot.

This equipment is client-side.
The actual equipment is not changed.

If the equipment slot is updated,
it will be reset.
DisplayEquipment.description:
Displays equipment on an entity
to a player. Equipment goes from
slots 2-7 in order of Helmet,
Chestplate, Leggings, Boots,
Main Hand, Off Hand.

GiveExp.name: Give Experience
GiveExp.description:
Adds experience points or
levels to a player.

FaceLocation.name: Face Location
FaceLocation.description:
Rotates a player to look
toward a location without
teleporting them.

ClearScoreboard.name: Clear Scoreboard
ClearScoreboard.description:
Removes all scores from
the scoreboard.

ActionBar.name: Show Action Bar Text

True.description:
Text style of the last value
will be inherited when merging
multiple values.

False.description:
Each value will have independent
text style when merging multiple
values.

additional_information:
Multiple variables (of any type)
will be merged into one message.
ActionBar.description:
Displays text directly above
a player's hotbar.

SetChatTag.name: Set Chat Tag
additional_information:
Multiple text items will be
merged into one chat tag.

ShiftWorldBorder.name: Shift World Border
ShiftWorldBorder.description:
Changes a player's world border
size if they have one active.

DisplaySignText.name: Display Sign Text
additional_information:
Displaying a sign text will
wipe any existing text on the
sign for the player.
DisplaySignText.description:
Displays text on a sign
to a player.

ExpandInv.name: Expand Inventory Menu
ExpandInv.description:
Adds 3 more rows to a player's
current inventory menu using the
contents of the chest.

LaunchProj.name: Launch Projectile

notes:
Controls how much random
motion is applied on launch

LaunchProj.description:
Launches a projectile from
a player.

ParticleCuboidA.name: Display Animated Particle Cuboid
ParticleCuboidA.description:

cuboid to a player.

SetCompass.name: Set Compass Target
SetCompass.description:

point to for a player.

location in the chest.

MobDisguise.name: Disguise as Mob

allows all blocks

Allows a player to place
and break certain blocks.

ParticleCircleA.name: Display Animated Particle Circle
ParticleCircleA.description:

of particles to a player.

equipment slots (armor and
held items) of a player.

SetDropsEnabled.description:
Sets whether a player drops
their items when dead.

The player will be prompted to
be sent to the specified plot.
The prompt may be denied by the player.
SendToPlot.description: Sends a player to another plot.

RemovePotion.name: Remove Potion Effect
additional_information:
Only the potion's type needs
to match; amplifier and duration
are disregarded.

Removes one or more potion
effects from a player.

additional_information: Disappears after 20s.

Displays a block fracture
effect at a location to a
player.

Color codes and style tags
are ignored when matching
an entity by its name.

All color codes and style
tags in the entity's name
must match exactly.

SetEntityHidden.description:
Sets if an entity is hidden
to a target.

SetSidebar.name: Set Sidebar Visible
SetSidebar.description:
Sets whether the scoreboard
sidebar is visible to a player.

DisplayHighlighter.description:
Highlights a specific block for a player.

showing text on top if provided.

SetSlot.description:
Sets a player's selected
hotbar slot.

Displays a ray of particles
to a player.

ParticleCuboid.description:

solid, hollow or wireframe
shape to a player.

SendMessageSeq.name: Send Message Sequence
SendMessageSeq.description:
Sends a series of messages
in chat to a player, with a
delay after each message.

SetNamePrefix.name: Set Name Prefix / Suffix
SetNamePrefix.description:
Sets the prefix or suffix
for the player's name.

ClearDispBlock.name: Clear Display Block

Block location,
or start of region

Displays the real block at a
location to a player, effectively
removing any client-side blocks.

SetRainLevel.name: Set Rain Level
additional_information:
The player's weather must be
set to Downfall to take effect.
SetRainLevel.description:
Sets the heaviness of rain and
storm visible to a player.

ParticleSpiralA.name: Display Animated Particle Spiral
ParticleSpiralA.description:
Displays an animated spiral of
particles to a player.

InstantRespawn.name: Set Instant Respawn
additional_information:
Also respawns a player if
they are dead.
InstantRespawn.description:
Sets if a player is instantly 
respawned upon dying.

SetScore.name: Set Scoreboard Score

scoreboard.

SetNameColor.description:

name tag appears in.

A percentage of what the attribute
is currently set to. For example,
200% doubles the current value.

Sets one of the player's reach-related
attributes such as block and
entity interaction ranges.

additional_information:
Lower tick rate makes the player
move in slower speed, and makes
various animations slower.

Tick rate of 0 does not affect
the player's movement and entities
will appear to be broken.

PlayEntitySound.name: Play Sound from Entity

Color codes and style tags
are ignored when matching
an entity by its name.

All color codes and style
tags in the entity's name
must match exactly.

Some sounds are not supported
to be played from an entity.

Plays a sound that follows a
moving entity or player.

SetExp.name: Set Experience
SetExp.description:

level, points or progress.

above. 100% is equal to the base value.

A percentage of what the attribute
is currently set to. For example,
200% doubles the current value.

attributes such as break speed
and mining efficiency.

KBAttribute.name: Set Knockback Attribute

A percentage of the base value shown
above. 100% is equal to the base value.

Percentage (Relative).description:
A percentage of what the attribute
is currently set to. For example,
200% doubles the current value.

KBAttribute.description:
Sets one of the player's knockback-related
attributes such as knockback resistance.

MovementAttribute.name: Set Movement Attribute

Percentage (Base).description:
A percentage of the base value shown
above. 100% is equal to the base value.

Percentage (Relative).description:
A percentage of what the attribute
is currently set to. For example,
200% doubles the current value.

MovementAttribute.description:
Sets one of the player's movement-related
attributes, such as walking speed
and jump height.

ParticleSpiral.name: Display Particle Spiral
ParticleSpiral.description:
Displays a spiral of particles
at a location to a player.

FallingAttribute.name: Set Falling Attribute

Percentage (Base).description:
A percentage of the base value shown
above. 100% is equal to the base value.

Percentage (Relative).description:
A percentage of what the attribute
is currently set to. For example,
200% doubles the current value.

attributes, such as gravity
and fall damage multiplier.

SetAllowFlight.name: Set Allow Flight
SetAllowFlight.description:
Sets whether a player
is able to enter and exit
flight mode by double
tapping jump.

RemoveBossBar.name: Remove Boss Bar
RemoveBossBar.description:
Removes a boss health bar
from a player's screen.

additional_information:
Fog distance cannot be higher
than the client's View Distance.
SetFogDistance.description:
Sets how far the fog is
displayed to a player.

AdventureMode.name: Set to Adventure Mode
AdventureMode.description:
Sets a player's game
mode to Adventure.

SpectatorMode.name: Set to Spectator Mode
SpectatorMode.description:

mode to Spectator.

will NOT revert if interacted with.

already be placed.
Works on client-side player heads.

Changes a head's texture at
a location for a player.

ClearPotions.name: Clear Potion Effects
ClearPotions.description:
Removes all active potion
effects from a player.

SetTabListInfo.name: Set Player List Info

Text style of the last value
will be inherited when merging
multiple values.

False.description:
Each value will have independent
text style when merging multiple
values.

additional_information:
Multiple variables (of any type)
will be merged into one message.
SetTabListInfo.description:
Sets the text to be displayed
above or below a player's player
list shown when pressing Tab.

PromptPurchase.name: Prompt Purchase
additional_information:
Plot products must be
approved before they
can be sold.
PromptPurchase.description:
Prompts the player to
purchase a plot product.

ScoreLineFormat.name: Set Scoreboard Line Number Format

Styled.description:
Displays a score number with
the specified text style.

additional_information:
Put an appropriate value in the chest
depending on the number format type.

Line number format overrides the default
number format of the whole scoreboard.
ScoreLineFormat.description:
Sets the number format of a
single line in the player's
scoreboard.

SetBossBar.name: Set Boss Bar

The boss bar has no
segments.

Each segment covers
16.66% of the boss bar.

10 segments.description:
Each segment covers
10% of the boss bar.

12 segments.description:
Each segment covers
8.33% of the boss bar.

Each segment covers
5% of the boss bar.

unused positions are not shown.

screen.

collides with blocks in
spectator mode.

name tag is visible.

upon taking damage.

remaining ticks until a
player can next be hurt.

currently existing entity or player.

character model.

the scoreboard.

to a player.

or start of region

This block is client-side. The
actual block is not changed.

block causes it to update.

Displays a block at a location to
a player.

RideEntity.name: Ride Entity

Color codes and style tags
are ignored when matching
an entity by its name.

False.description:
All color codes and style
tags in the entity's name
must match exactly.

RideEntity.description:
Mounts a player on top of
another player or entity.

ResourcePack.name: Send Resource Pack

notes: Must link directly to a .zip file.

additional_information:
Resource packs may only be
sent once per player.

Resource packs are limited to
10 MiB in size, but can be
upgraded to 40 MiB with /plot addons.
ResourcePack.description: Send a resource pack to a player.

SetInvName.name: Set Inventory Menu Name
SetInvName.description:
Renames a player's current
inventory menu.

Teleport.name: Teleport

Teleports a player to
a location.

SetAllowPVP.name: Set PvP Allowed
SetAllowPVP.description:
Sets whether a player can
hurt or be hurt by other
players.

SetVisualFire.name: Set Visual Fire

fire ticks won't change
and won't take any damage.

container at a location.

Blocks such as chests will

Blocks such as chests will not

region, including air.

triggered this line of code.

SetLecternBook.name: Set Lectern Book

displayed page of a Lectern.

CancelEvent.name: Cancel Event

Events cannot be cancelled
after a Control: Wait block.
CancelEvent.description:

triggered this line of code.

SpawnFangs.name: Spawn Evoker Fangs
additional_information:
Evoker Fangs deal damage
and remove themselves a
second later.
SpawnFangs.description:
Spawns evoker fangs at a
location.

SetEventSound.name: Set Event Sound
SetEventSound.description:

this event, replacing the
original sound.

SetEventXP.name: Set Event Experience

this event should drop.

LockContainer.name: Set Container Lock
additional_information:
Lock keys determine the name of
the item used to open the container.
LockContainer.description:
Sets the lock key of the container
at a location.

SetExhaustion.name: Set Event Exhaustion
SetExhaustion.description:

gained in this event.

AdvanceTime.name: Set Advance Time
AdvanceTime.description:

natural time cycle.

ClearItems.name: Clear Container Items
ClearItems.description:

the container at a location.

SetFurnaceSpeed.name: Set Furnace Cook Time
additional_information:
By default, a furnace cooks
in 200 ticks.

Fuel duration is unaffected
by cooking time.
SetFurnaceSpeed.description:
Sets the amount of ticks it
takes for a furnace block
to cook an item.

BlockDropsOn.name: Enable Block Drops
BlockDropsOn.description:
Enables blocks dropping
as items when broken.

ViewDistance.name: Set World View Distance
ViewDistance.description: Sets the view distance in the world.

BoneMeal.name: Bone Meal Block
BoneMeal.description: Applies bone meal to a block.

Converts the block at
the location to a falling block)

Falling blocks automatically
disappear after 30 seconds.

Spawns a falling block at a
location.

SetDisplayedItem.name: Set Event Displayed Item
SetDisplayedItem.description:
Sets the item displayed
in this event.

DiscordWebhook.name: Send Discord Webhook Message
DiscordWebhook.description:
Sends a message to a Discord
webhook.

TickBlock.name: Random Tick Block
TickBlock.description:
Causes a block to get "random
ticked", which could cause a
block update.

ReplaceItems.name: Replace Container Items
ReplaceItems.description:
Replaces items in the container
at a location with the given item.

SetEventProj.name: Set Event Projectile
SetEventProj.description:
Replaces the projectile fired in
the Shoot Bow Event.

RandomTickSpeed.name: Set World Random Tick Speed
RandomTickSpeed.description:
Sets the random tick speed
 in the world.

Explosion.name: Create Explosion
Explosion.description: Creates an explosion at a location.

SpawnMob.name: Spawn Mob
additional_information:
Equipment goes from the bottom
left corner towards the right:

Main Hand, Helmet, Chestplate,
Leggings, Boots, Off Hand
SpawnMob.description: Spawns a mob at a location.

SetBrushableItem.name: Set Item in Brushable Block
SetBrushableItem.description:
Sets the item buried in a
suspicious sand or gravel.

SpawnEnderEye.name: Spawn Eye of Ender

Drop item.description:
The eye always drops itself
as an item.

Random.description:
The eye has a 20% chance
of shattering.

additional_information:
If the destination is further
than 12 blocks away, the eye's
path always goes upwards.
SpawnEnderEye.description:
Spawns an eye of ender at a
location, which (if specified) will
float towards its destination.

SpawnPotionCloud.name: Spawn Area of Effect Cloud
SpawnPotionCloud.description:
Spawns a lingering potion cloud
at a location that imbues effects
onto entities who enter it.

notes:
Controls how much random
motion is applied on launch

SetBlock.name: Set Block
additional_information:
Will cause block updates. Use SetRegion
to not update nearby blocks and
save CPU.
SetBlock.description: Sets the block at a location.

SpawnItemDisp.name: Spawn Item Display
additional_information:
Notable defaults:
⏵ Billboard = Fixed

SetBlockGrowth.name: Set Block Growth
additional_information:
Most crops have growth stages
from 0 to 7.
SetBlockGrowth.description:
Sets the growth stage of the block
(eg. carrots) at a location.

SetContainerName.name: Set Container Name
SetContainerName.description:
Sets the name of the container
at a location.

SetHead.name: Set Player Head
SetHead.description:
Sets the block at a location
to a player head.

RemoveItems.name: Remove Container Items
RemoveItems.description:
Removes items from the container
at a location.

SetRegion.name: Set Region
additional_information:
Can set up to 100,000 blocks per
action.

Will not cause block updates. A 1x1x1
SetRegion may save CPU compared to
SetBlock in certain situations.
SetRegion.description: Fills a region with a type of block.

VineSpreading.name: Set Vine Spreading
VineSpreading.description: Sets if this world spreads vines.

SpawnTNT.name: Spawn Primed TNT
SpawnTNT.description: Spawns primed TNT at a location.

SpawnExpOrb.name: Spawn Experience Orb
SpawnExpOrb.description:
Spawns an experience orb at
a location.

SetBiome.name: Set Biome
additional_information:
Can set up to 100,000 blocks per
action.

Players may have to reload the chunks
on their client to see a change.
SetBiome.description: Sets the biome of a region.

SetEventHeal.name: Set Event Heal Amount
SetEventHeal.description:
Sets the amount of health
regained in this event.

ApplyTransaction.name: Apply Transaction
additional_information:
Can set up to 1,000,000 blocks
per transaction.
Only 1 transaction can be active at a time.

Transactions are asynchronous, and
may override blocks set after them.
ApplyTransaction.description:
Applies the current transaction
and generates a new one.

GenerateTree.name: Generate Tree
additional_information:
The location is the northwest
corner of 2x2 trees.

Trees will not grow on blocks
that do not normally support
tree growth.
GenerateTree.description: Generates a tree at a location.

SpawnCrystal.name: Spawn End Crystal
SpawnCrystal.description:
Spawns an end crystal at a
location.

SetCampfireItem.name: Set Campfire Item

1.description:
Sets the item on the
southwest corner
of the campfire.

2.description:
Sets the item on the
northwest corner
of the campfire.

3.description:
Sets the item on the
northeast corner
of the campfire.

4.description:
Sets the item on the
southeast corner
of the campfire.

additional_information:
After the cooking time, the
item drops from the campfire
(unless the campfire is unlit).
SetCampfireItem.description:
Sets the item being cooked in
one of a campfire's slots.

SpawnTextDisplay.name: Spawn Text Display

True.description:
Text style of the last value
will be inherited when merging
multiple values.

False.description:
Each value will have independent
text style when merging multiple
values.

additional_information:
Notable defaults:
⏵ Line Width = 200
⏵ Text Alignment = Center
⏵ Billboard = Center

SpawnVehicle.name: Spawn Vehicle
SpawnVehicle.description: Spawns a vehicle at a location.

Lightning.name: Summon Lightning
additional_information:
The lightning's damage can be
detected using the "lightning"
damage event cause.

BlockDropsOff.name: Disable Block Drops
BlockDropsOff.description:
Disables blocks dropping
as items when broken.

SetEventCurrent.name: Set Event Redstone Current Strength
SetEventCurrent.description:
Sets the current strength
in this event.

RandomPlayer.name: Select Random Player
RandomPlayer.description:
Creates a selection using
one or more random
players in the game.

LastEntity.name: Select Last-Spawned Entity
LastEntity.description:
Creates a selection using
the most recently spawned
entity.

EntityName.name: Select Entities by Name

True.description:
Color codes and style tags
are ignored when matching
an entity by its name.

False.description:
All color codes and style
tags in the entity's name
must match exactly.

EntityName.description:
Creates a selection using all
entities in the game whose
name or UUID matches.

FilterRandom.name: Filter Selection Randomly
FilterRandom.description:
Filters the selection by
randomly picking one or
more objects from it.

EntityUUID.name: Select Entities by UUID
additional_information:
This action selects entities
directly and is much faster
than normal selections.
EntityUUID.description:
Creates a selection of all
entities in the game with
the given UUIDs.

PlayerName.name: Select Players by Name
PlayerName.description:
Creates a selection using all
players in the game whose
name or UUID matches.

AllEntities.name: Select All Entities
AllEntities.description:
Creates a selection of
all entities in the game.

FilterDistance.name: Filter Selection by Distance
FilterDistance.description:
Filters the selection to the
objects that are nearest
or farthest to a location.

FilterRay.name: Filter Selection by Raycast

Solid blocks.description:
Passes through non-solid
blocks such as tall grass,
and through fluids.

arguments.description:
Gets the end or
final hit location

FilterRay.description:
Filters the selected objects
to the objects that intersect
a ray.

Reset.name: Reset Selection
Reset.description:
Deactivates the selection.
Code that follows will run
normally with event targets.

EventTarget.name: Select Event Target

Default.description:
The target that triggered
this event.

Killer.description:
The target that killed the
victim in this event.

Damager.description:
The target that harmed the
victim in this event.

Victim.description:
The target that was harmed
or killed in this event.

Shooter.description:
The target that fired a
projectile in this event.

EventTarget.description:
Creates a selection using
a target involved in this
Event.

EntitiesCond.name: Select Entities by Condition
additional_information:
Can be inverted with the
NOT Arrow.
EntitiesCond.description:
Creates a selection of
all entities in the game
that meet a condition.

AllPlayers.name: Select All Players
AllPlayers.description:
Creates a selection of
all players in the game.

Invert.name: Invert Selection
additional_information:
If the current selection
contains players, all other
players are selected.

If the current selection
contains entities, all other
entities are selected.
Invert.description:
Creates a new selection by
inverting the selection that
is currently active.

FilterCondition.name: Filter Selection by Condition
additional_information:
Can be inverted with the
NOT Arrow.
FilterCondition.description:
Filters the selection to the
objects that meet a certain
condition.

FilterSort.name: Filter Selection by Sort
FilterSort.description:
Filters the selection by
sorting the value of each
object in order.

PlayersCond.name: Select Players by Condition
additional_information:
Can be inverted with the
NOT Arrow.
PlayersCond.description:
Creates a selection of
all players in the game
that meet a condition.

StopRepeat.description:
Stops a Repeat sequence and
continues to the next code block.

Return.name: Return From Function
additional_information:
This occurs automatically
at the end of a Function.
Return.description:
Skips the rest of a Function
sequence and returns to the
block it was called from.

PrintDebug.name: Send Debug Message

Sends to the plot owner.
Works even if not on the plot.

Developer.description:
Sends to players that
have dev perms.

Builder.description:
Sends to players that
have build perms.

Developer or builder.description:
Sends to players that
have dev or build perms.

Whitelisted.description:
Sends to players that
are whitelisted on the plot.

All.description:
Sends to all players
that are on the plot.

Default.description:
Plays the default sound
for the message style.

Custom.description:
No message style is applied.

Sends a debug message.

Plays a sound by default.

Info.description:
Sends an info message.

Sends a LagSlayer message.

Preview: [LagSlayer] Example

Players must be on the plot
to receive debug messages.

Multiple values (of any type)
will be merged together.
PrintDebug.description:
Sends a formatted message to
the specified plot staff group
regardless of which mode
they're currently in.
Clicking on the message will
teleport you to this block.

Skip.name: Skip Iteration
Skip.description:
Skips the rest of this repeat
statement's code and continues
to the next repetition.

End.name: End Thread
additional_information:
This occurs automatically
when a thread has no valid
event targets or selection.
A player target is invalid
if they have left the game.
End.description:
Stops the current event
thread. Any code after this
block will not be executed.

Wait.name: Wait
additional_information:
It is not possible to wait
fractions of a tick.
Wait.description:
Pauses the current code
sequence for a duration of
ticks, seconds, or minutes.

<=.name: Number ≤

less than or equal to another
number.

ItemHasEnchant.name: Item Has Enchantment
additional_information:
A level of 0 will work
for any level.

given enchantment, or,
if no enchantment is specified,
checks if it has any.

able to be placed.

for the given key is equal to
any of the given values.

given custom tag, and (if
provided) whether the tag
matches the given value.

ListSizeEquals.description: Checks if a list is of a given size.

other values.

would be filtered by the
selected chat filters.

StartsWith.description:

a string value matches a
certain string.

ListValueEq.name: List Value Equals
ListValueEq.description:
Checks if a list's value at an
index is equal to a value.

VarIsType.name: Value Is Type
VarIsType.description:
Checks if a value is of a
certain type.

Block locations are compared.
Does not affect number ranges.

Exact.description:
Exact decimal locations are compared.
Does not affect number ranges.

in between 2 other numbers or
a location value is within the
region of 2 other locations.

the given keys.

BlockIsSolid.name: Block Is Solid

Checks if a material will collide
with entities.

ItemEquals.name: Item Equals
ItemEquals.description:
Works the same as Value =
but has a few extra options
for item comparison.

ListContains.name: List Contains Value

If multiple values are given, the
condition will return true if one
of the values are found.
ListContains.description:
Checks if any of a list's contents
match the given value.

is within the radius.

within the radius.

Checks if the distance
on the X, Y or Z axis
is within the radius.

Checks if the distance
on the X or Z axis is
within the radius.

near another location.

Checks if the last part of
a string value matches a
certain string.

is greater than or equal to
another number.

DictHasKey.name: Dictionary Has Key
DictHasKey.description:

the given key.

Gets the current

Repeats code once for each
block adjacent to a location.

Sets the rotation of each
returned location to face
the next given path point.

False.description:
Keeps the rotation of the
given path points.

arguments.description:
Gets the current
path location each iteration

Repeats code once for
each interpolated point in
a path of locations.

Gets the
current index each iteration

arguments.description:
Gets the current
block location each iteration

Repeats code once for each
block in a region in order:
X → Z → Y. Iterates from the
first to the second location.

DoWhile.description:
Repeats code as long as a
condition is true.
The condition is evaluated
at the end of each
loop iteration.

While.name: Repeat While
While.description:
Repeats code as long as a
condition is true.
The condition is evaluated
before each loop iteration.

arguments.description:
Gets the current
value each iteration

Repeats code once for each
index of a list.

Gets the current
sphere location each iteration

evenly distributed sphere point.

The Control: Wait block can
be used for a delay.

Gets the current
number each iteration

To iterate in the negative direction,
you must use a negative step size.

number on a number line.

target related values

this thread's event

Particles produced
by entities when attacked

health points.
additional_information: ❤ = 2 Health

returns.description:
0.0 (dead) up
to the target's maximum
health (20.0 by default)

Maximum Health.description:

health points.
additional_information: ❤ = 2 Health

Absorption Health.description:
Gets a target's
absorption health
(golden hearts).
additional_information: ❤ = 2 Health

Food Level.description:
Gets a target's remaining
food points.

Food Saturation.description:
Gets a target's saturation level,
which depends on the types
of food consumed.
additional_information:
If saturation is > 0.0, the
player's food level will not drop.

returns.description:
0.0 (minimum), up to
the player's food level

Food Exhaustion.description:
Gets a target's exhaustion
level, which is increased
by the player's actions.
additional_information:
When exhaustion resets
from 4.0 to 0.0, a player's
saturation decreases by 1.

Gets a target's attack damage,
which has a base value that
can be altered by items.
additional_information: Default base value = 1.0

Attack Speed.description:
Gets a target's attack speed,
which has a base value that
can be altered by items.
additional_information: Default base value = 4.0

Attack Cooldown.description:
Gets a target's current attack
cooldown as a percentage of the
way to fully charged

Attack Cooldown Ticks.description:
Gets the number of ticks
it will take to fully charge a
target's attack cooldown after
attacking with their held item.
additional_information:
This value is set to -1
if it will never recharge.

Armor Points.description:
Gets a target's armor points,
which has a base value that
can be altered by items.
additional_information: Default base value = 0.0

Armor Toughness.description:
Gets a target's armor toughness,
which has a base value that
can be altered by items.
additional_information:
Armor Toughness increases 
the amount of damage required
to penetrate one armor point.
Default base value = 0.0

returns.description:
0.0 or above (full
set of diamond armor = 8.0)

Invulnerability Ticks.description:
Gets a target's remaining
ticks of invulnerability.
additional_information:
This value is set to 10
upon taking damage.

Experience Progress.description:
Gets a target's experience
progress percentage to
the next level.

Fire Ticks.description:
Gets the remaining ticks a
target is on fire for.

Freeze Ticks.description:
Gets the remaining ticks a
target is freezing for.

Remaining Air.description:
Gets a target's remaining
air ticks.
additional_information:
One breath bubble is
equal to 30 air ticks.

Fall Distance.description:
Gets a target's distance fallen
in blocks.
additional_information: Resets to 0 upon landing.
Works on the Damage Event.

Held Slot.description:
Gets a target's selected
hotbar slot index.

Ping.description:
Gets the latency between
a player and the server
in milliseconds.

Steer Sideways Movement.description:
While a player is steering
an entity, gets the sideways
movement of the steering.

Steer Forward Movement.description:
While a player is steering
an entity, gets the forward
movement of the steering.

Gets the progress percentage
of a target using their held
item, such as food.

Bows, crossbows and tridents
remain at 100.0% until they
are released.

Gets a target's flight
speed as a percentage.

Walk Speed.description:
Gets a target's walk
speed as a percentage.

bounding box.

Entity Height.description:
Gets the height of an entity's
bounding box.

returns.description:
Location and
rotation, at feet height

block a target is looking at.

Gets the side of the
block a target is looking
at as a direction.

Eye Location.description:

adjusted to its eye height.

Gets the X coordinate
of a target's position.

Y-Coordinate.description:
Gets the Y coordinate
of a target's position.

Z-Coordinate.description:
Gets the Z coordinate
of a target's position.

Midpoint Location.description:
Gets the location of the center of
the target's bounding box.

Pitch.description:
Gets the pitch (up/down
rotation) of a target's
position.
additional_information: 90.0° = down

Yaw.description:
Gets the yaw (left/right
rotation) of a target's
position.
additional_information: 0.0° = south
90.0° = west

Body Yaw.description:
Gets the yaw (left/right
rotation) of a target's
body.
additional_information: 0.0° = south
90.0° = west

Standing Block Location.description:
Gets the location of the block
that is supporting the player.
additional_information:
When not grounded, this will
return the location of the block
at the target's location.

Spawn Location.description:
Gets a target's original spawn
location.

returns.description:
Location this
entity was created at

Velocity.description:
Gets the speed at which a
target is moving (not walking)
in each direction.
additional_information:
When grounded, a target may
still have a downward velocity
due to how gravity is applied.

Direction.description:
Gets the looking direction
of a target's location as
a vector.

Main Hand Item.description:
Gets a target's currently
held item.

returns.description:
Item in the
selected hotbar slot

Off Hand Item.description:
Gets a target's currently
held off hand item.

Armor Items.description:
Gets the items in a target's
armor slots.
additional_information:
Armor slots are ordered
from helmet to boots.

returns.description:
Contains one Item
entry for each armor
slot (air if empty, 4 in
total)

Gets a target's current
hotbar items.

returns.description:
